objective_only.description: Uses only objective delta. This matches the current preliminary ranking.

balanced_operational.description: Balances objective, makespan, travel time, lateness, and replanning effort.

makespan_priority.description: Penalizes makespan strongly and is useful when finishing later is operationally expensive.

conservative_replanning.description: Penalizes replanning effort and favors stability unless benefits are clear.

interpretation.warning: This report recalculates alternative ranking profiles from existing aggregate result rows. It is diagnostic and does not replace final statistical validation.
